frame.x: feet east of the west fence, along the north fence
frame.y: feet south of the north fence, along the west fence
frame.alignment: The fences run within 0.2 degrees of true north-south and east-west, so +x is east and +y is south.

parcel_likely.note: Likely 10-acre legal parcel (330 x 1,320 ft) measured to the road centerlines; not surveyed.

grid.how: Column letter A-G west to east, row number 1-26 north to south, 50 ft cells. Example: B19 is x 50-100, y 900-950.

georef.datum: NAD83 (same as WGS84 / GPS to within about 1 m here)
georef.formula: lat = lat[0] + lat[1]*x + lat[2]*y; lon = lon[0] + lon[1]*x + lon[2]*y (x, y in feet; exact to under 1 cm across the lot)

utm.formula: E = E0 + 0.3048*(x*cos t - y*sin t); N = N0 - 0.3048*(x*sin t + y*cos t)

georef.check: The owner's Google Maps pin on the red shed falls 5 ft from the shed roof center measured on USGS imagery.
georef.source: Lot frame fitted to the four fence lines on USGS NAIP imagery (0.52 m pixels, UTM zone 11N).

orchard.how: Tree R(r)-C(c) stands at x = c1_x + (c - 1) * tree_spacing, plus even_row_offset in even rows, and y = r1_y - (r - 1) * row_spacing.

features.name: Fence (lot line)
features.notes: Fenced lot, 331 x 1,292 ft (9.83 acres).

features.name: Middle of the lot (east-west midline)
features.notes: Halfway down the fenced lot: 645.95 ft south of the north fence, half of the 1,291.9 ft fence length, marked by a red tick on each fence on the site master grid. The owner's red lines on the October 2026 drone photo read about 660 ft, which is half of the likely 1,320 ft parcel counted from the road; the north fence stands about 18 to 20 ft inside the road line, so the lot's own middle is nearer 646. Tape from the northwest fence corner to check.

features.name: Driveway entrance

features.name: Front entrance gate
features.notes: Two 12 ft metal gates that swing both ways, hung on treated junior railroad ties (probably about 8 x 12 in, the owner's estimate) set in concrete, across the driveway where it enters the lot in cell G1 (24 ft between the posts). In the October 10 and 19, 2026 drone photos both leaves stand open along the driveway. The owner says the east post stands about 5 ft inside the east fence line (the photos had put it on the fence line), so the whole gate sits 5 ft west of that first reading; the photos put it about 10 ft inside the mapped north fence line, at the south edge of the grass strip along the road. Position good to about 8 ft.

features.name: Water main, 2 in PVC

Eight 10 ft row laterals (water_lateral_row_1 to 8) and the north hydrant lateral tee off its west side between y 40 and y 560.
